summary: Add optional urtlog dependency extra in pyproject.toml

delivery.outcome: Declare optional [project.optional-dependencies] urtlog extra in pyproject.toml without adding mandatory runtime dependencies.
nonGoals: Changing default Monag observation behavior when URTLOG_STATE_DIR is unset

architecture.decision: Expose uritime-urtlog>=0.3.0 strictly under [project.optional-dependencies] urtlog so offline CI and core installs remain unchanged while monag[urtlog] installs cleanly from a wheelhouse or registry.

validation.evidence: Verified optional urtlog extra declaration, untouched mandatory dependencies, pytest pass, and GOV-PASS.
